command: set -eu; mkdir -p /tmp/source; cd /tmp/source; tar -xf -; chown -R 1000:1000 /tmp/source; su -s /bin/sh vscode -c "git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=HOST2-check -c user.email=host2-check@invalid commit -qm snapshot"; python -m pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps .; su -s /bin/sh vscode -c "export PATH=/opt/venv/bin:/usr/local/share/nvm/current/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin; cd /tmp/source && make check"
scope: Git archive in disposable development-image container, no network or Docker socket, private runtime tmpfs, synthetic Git commit; not an experiment, smoke, or freeze approval.
